name: Yoshi coins
description: Checks the Yoshi coins (dragon coins) of the level. 'Collected so far' counts the ones of this attempt ($1420) and starts again after a death. 'All five collected before' looks at the flag the game saves once the five were collected (the bit of the level in $1F2F-$1F3A, picked by the level number in $13BF with the game's bit table at $0DA8A6), which stays after a death.
author: BlockCreator
